content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user who manages tasks","i_want":"to mark a task as Completed and revert a Completed task back to Open","so_that":"I can record which work is finished and reopen work that needs more effort","business_description":"Users change the Status of a task between Open and Completed. Completing a task records a Completion Date. Reverting a Completed task sets its Status back to Open. Every change updates the Last Updated Date. The frontend shows a success or error message after each change and never shows a success state before the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Users can see which tasks are finished and reopen tasks that were completed too early, so the task list reflects the actual state of the work.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with Status Open exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed and the backend confirms the change","then":"the task Status is Completed, the Completion Date is set to the date of the change, and a success message is shown"},{"given":"a task with Status Completed exists","when":"the user reverts the task to Open and the backend confirms the change","then":"the task Status is Open and a success message is shown"},{"given":"a task with Status Open exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed and the backend returns an error","then":"the task Status remains Open, the UI does not show the task as Completed, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"a task with Status Completed exists","when":"the user reverts the task and the backend returns an error","then":"the task Status remains Completed, the UI does not show the task as Open, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"a task is marked as Completed","when":"the status change is saved","then":"the Last Updated Date of the task is set to the time of the change"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist","when":"a status change request is sent for that ID","then":"the backend returns a Task Not Found error response"}],"edge_cases":["Completing a task that is already Completed: the PRD does not state the expected result. Open question: reject, ignore, or keep the original Completion Date.","Reverting a task that is already Open: the PRD does not state the expected result. Open question.","Completion Date after a revert: the PRD does not say whether it is cleared or kept. Open question.","The PRD lists In Progress as a valid Status but does not say how a task enters or leaves In Progress. This story covers only Completed and Open.","Status change request for a task that was deleted by another user: the backend returns a Task Not Found error and the frontend shows an error message.","Backend unavailable or database error during a status change: the backend returns an internal error and the frontend shows an error message without changing the displayed status."],"dependencies":["US-create-and-view-tasks"],"definition_of_done":["Status field with allowed values Open, In Progress and Completed exists on every task","Completion Date and Last Updated Date fields exist on every task","Status change endpoint accepts Completed and Open and returns the updated task","Error responses for Task Not Found and invalid input are returned in the simple format defined in the PRD","Frontend shows a success or error message after each status change","Frontend does not show a success state before the backend confirms the change","Automated tests pass for all acceptance criteria"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-status-fields-migration","title":"[BE] Add Status, Completion Date and Last Updated Date columns to tasks table","track":"backend","area":"db","description":"Add a Status column restricted to Open, In Progress and Completed, a nullable Completion Date column and a Last Updated Date column to the tasks table.
